key.decision_why: The PR keeps the same one-line fix and only adds commits that make CI pass. A short note that it now looks ready for review is enough, and a new card is not needed.
key.action_why: On 2026-10-08, hours after the ping, laurynmm removed "not ready", added "maintainer review" and assigned 0xthedance.
changed: Added a commit that reverts the Gitea pull_request__merged.json fixture to its original data, undoing commit 5de2a7115c09, which the author says faked the data for a docs screenshot.
Added a commit that fixes Gogs and Gitea tests whose expected topic PR numbers did not match the messages.
CI now passes, after failing on the first push.
Explained in a comment why CI failed and what the two extra commits do.
key.reply_ask: Thank the author for fixing the tests and fixture so CI passes, and tell them the PR is moving to maintainer review with a reviewer assigned.

must_have.fact: Says CI now passes after the author fixed the Gogs/Gitea tests and the Gitea fixture, which addresses the likely reason for the "not ready" label.
Recommends removing "not ready", adding "maintainer review" and assigning a reviewer, because no further author work is outstanding.
Notes that the "not ready" label came with no written maintainer feedback, so there was no explicit ask left to check.
Flags for the reviewer that the PR reverts the Gitea pull_request__merged.json fixture, which was used for a docs screenshot, so the docs image may need a look.
Suggests an integrations reviewer, such as Niloth P, who recently changed these webhook files.
